-- Local cinematic props. No external models or uploaded animation assets required.
local A={}
local V,C=Vector3.new,Color3.fromRGB
local WHITE,ICE,INK=C(251,254,255),C(147,225,255),C(29,73,101)
function A.part(parent,name,size,cf,color,shape)
 local p=Instance.new("Part");p.Name=name;p.Size=size;p.CFrame=cf;p.Color=color or WHITE
 p.Anchored=true;p.CanCollide=false;p.CanQuery=false;p.CanTouch=false;p.CastShadow=false
 p.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic;p.TopSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth;p.BottomSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
 if shape=="ball" then local mesh=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");mesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Sphere;mesh.Parent=p
 elseif shape=="cylinder" then p.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder end
 p.Parent=parent;return p
end
function A.rod(parent,name,a,b,r,color)
 return A.part(parent,name,V((b-a).Magnitude,r*2,r*2),CFrame.lookAt((a+b)/2,b)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi/2,0),color,"cylinder")
end
function A.shovel(parent)
 local m=Instance.new("Model");m.Name="HeroShovel"
 A.rod(m,"WoodenShaft",V(0,-1.35,0),V(0,1.18,0),.115,C(167,112,64))
 A.rod(m,"WoodHighlight",V(-.06,-1.22,-.095),V(-.06,1.1,-.095),.018,C(233,181,112))
 A.part(m,"Blade",V(1.38,1.32,.24),CFrame.new(0,-1.83,0),C(102,190,224),"ball")
 A.part(m,"BladeCenter",V(.94,.94,.16),CFrame.new(0,-1.71,-.12),C(184,238,255),"ball")
 A.rod(m,"ScoopLip",V(-.5,-2.25,-.05),V(.5,-2.25,-.05),.065,ICE)
 A.rod(m,"Socket",V(0,-1.45,0),V(0,-1.08,0),.18,INK)
 -- Open D grip with a curved top and a straight wooden crossbar.
 for i=0,9 do
  local a,b=math.pi*i/10,math.pi*(i+1)/10
  A.rod(m,"DGrip",V(math.cos(a)*.5,1.45+math.sin(a)*.5,0),V(math.cos(b)*.5,1.45+math.sin(b)*.5,0),.075,INK)
 end
 A.rod(m,"GripBase",V(-.5,1.45,0),V(.5,1.45,0),.085,C(186,130,75))
 for s=-1,1,2 do A.rod(m,"GripFork",V(0,1.1,0),V(s*.5,1.45,0),.065,INK) end
 local h=Instance.new("Highlight");h.FillTransparency=1;h.OutlineColor=INK;h.OutlineTransparency=.45;h.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded;h.Parent=m
 local light=Instance.new("PointLight");light.Name="RevealLight";light.Color=ICE;light.Range=8;light.Brightness=0;light.Parent=m.Blade
 m.WorldPivot=CFrame.new();m.Parent=parent
 return m,light
end
function A.scene(parent,origin)
 local m=Instance.new("Model");m.Name="WinterSet"
 -- Snow around the landing and a small mound around the planted blade.
 A.part(m,"LandingSnow",V(8,1.8,6),CFrame.new(-4,.03,0),WHITE,"ball")
 A.part(m,"ShovelSnow",V(3,.65,2.5),CFrame.new(3,.02,-1.1),WHITE,"ball")
 -- Compact igloo in the background, with chunky snow bricks and an open dark doorway.
 local center=V(14,-.2,20)
 A.part(m,"IglooDome",V(15,13,15),CFrame.new(center),C(225,245,255),"ball")
 for row=0,3 do
  local y=1+row*1.35
  local radius=7.2*math.sqrt(1-(y/7.3)^2)
  local n=20-row*3
  for i=0,n-1 do
   local angle=(i+(row%2)*.5)*math.pi*2/n
   local pos=center+V(math.sin(angle)*radius,y,math.cos(angle)*radius)
   A.part(m,"SnowBrick",V(radius*math.pi*2/n*.92,1.16,.38),CFrame.new(pos)*CFrame.Angles(0,angle,0),row%2==0 and WHITE or C(214,237,251))
  end
 end
 A.part(m,"DoorwayShadow",V(3.2,4.3,.18),CFrame.new(center+V(0,1.5,-7.3)),C(43,99,138),"ball")
 for i=0,8 do
  local a=i*math.pi/8
  local pos=center+V(math.cos(a)*2,1+math.sin(a)*2.4,-7.6)
  A.part(m,"EntranceArch",V(1.03,1.1,1.6),CFrame.new(pos)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,a-math.pi/2),WHITE)
 end
 -- Frame the high sky with a few soft clouds. Existing world mountains stay visible below.
 for i=1,3 do
  for j=-1,1 do A.part(m,"Cloud",V(14,6,8),CFrame.new(-28+i*20+j*5,67+i*4,26+i*7),WHITE,"ball") end
 end
 m.WorldPivot=CFrame.new();m:PivotTo(origin);m.Parent=parent
 return m
end
return A

-- Seven-second, time-based cinematic. Camera/controls are restored on every exit path.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local Input=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CAS=game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local Lighting=game:GetService("Lighting")
local Art=require(RS:WaitForChild("SnowIntroArt"))
local Request=RS:WaitForChild("SnowIntroRequest")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local M={}
local V,C=Vector3.new,Color3.fromRGB
local WHITE,ICE=C(252,255,255),C(147,226,255)
local rad=math.rad
local function ease(t) t=math.clamp(t,0,1);return t*t*(3-2*t)end
local function mix(a,b,t)return a+(b-a)*math.clamp(t,0,1)end
local function angles(x,y,z)return CFrame.Angles(rad(x or 0),rad(y or 0),rad(z or 0))end
local function mk(class,props,parent)local o=Instance.new(class);for k,v in pairs(props)do o[k]=v end;o.Parent=parent;return o end
local function cf(pos,target)return CFrame.lookAt(pos,target)end
local function pose(t)
 local p={x=-4,y=0,yaw=0,roll=0,pitch=0,rs=V(0,0,0),ls=V(0,0,0),rh=V(0,0,0),lh=V(0,0,0),neck=V(0,0,0),re=0,le=0,rk=0,lk=0}
 if t<2 then
  local u=t/2
  p.y=48*(1-u*u)
  p.roll=math.sin(t*8)*14*(1-u)+math.sin(u*math.pi*2)*30
  p.yaw=math.sin(u*math.pi)*105
  p.pitch=math.sin(t*5)*13
  p.rs=V(110+math.sin(t*17)*24,0,-35)
  p.ls=V(115-math.sin(t*19)*25,0,35)
  p.rh=V(math.sin(t*18)*25,0,-15);p.lh=V(-math.sin(t*18)*25,0,15)
 elseif t<2.3 then
  local u=ease((t-2)/.3);p.y=mix(0,-1.8,u);p.pitch=18*u
  p.rs=V(-25,0,-38);p.ls=V(-25,0,38);p.rh=V(-25,0,0);p.lh=p.rh
 elseif t<2.7 then
  local u=ease((t-2.3)/.4);p.y=mix(-1.8,.18,u);p.pitch=mix(18,-8,u)
  p.rs=V(10,0,-25);p.ls=V(10,0,25);p.neck=V(-12,math.sin(t*19)*22,0)
 elseif t<3.25 then
  p.y=math.sin((t-2.7)*math.pi/.55)*.12;p.roll=math.sin(t*29)*6*(1-(t-2.7)/.55)
  p.rs=V(10,0,-25);p.ls=V(10,0,25);p.neck=V(-5,math.sin((t-2.7)*10)*28,0)
 elseif t<4.5 then
  local u=ease((t-3.25)/.4);p.neck=V(-8,-38*u,-10*u)
  p.rs=V(15,0,-16);p.ls=V(15,0,16);p.pitch=-5*u
 elseif t<5.12 then
  local u=ease((t-4.5)/.62);p.x=mix(-4,3,u);p.y=math.abs(math.sin((t-4.5)*20))*.3
  p.yaw=-90*(1-ease((u-.7)/.3));p.pitch=10
  p.rs=V(math.sin(t*21)*42,0,-7);p.ls=V(-math.sin(t*21)*42,0,7)
  p.rh=V(-math.sin(t*21)*35,0,0);p.lh=V(math.sin(t*21)*35,0,0)
  p.rk=math.max(0,math.sin(t*21))*35;p.lk=math.max(0,-math.sin(t*21))*35
 elseif t<5.48 then
  local u=ease((t-5.12)/.36);p.x=3;p.y=-.42*math.sin(u*math.pi);p.pitch=18*math.sin(u*math.pi)
  p.rs=V(mix(70,155,u),-15,-18);p.ls=V(mix(65,145,u),18,18)
  p.re=-18;p.le=-25;p.neck=V(-18,0,0)
 elseif t<6 then
  local u=ease((t-5.48)/.3);p.x=3;p.y=math.sin(u*math.pi)*.18
  p.rs=V(155,0,-18);p.ls=V(mix(145,20,u),0,24);p.neck=V(-20,0,-5)
 elseif t<6.55 then
  local u=ease((t-6)/.55);p.x=3;p.rs=V(mix(155,60,u),0,-28)
  p.ls=V(10,0,30);p.roll=-4*math.sin(u*math.pi);p.neck=V(-7,0,0)
 else
  local u=ease((t-6.55)/.45);p.x=3;p.rs=V(mix(60,0,u),0,mix(-28,0,u));p.ls=V(0,0,mix(30,0,u))
 end
 return p
end
local function cameraAt(t,h)
 local pos,target,fov
 if t<2 then
  local u=ease(t/2);local y=48*(1-(t/2)^2)+h
  pos=V(mix(14,10,u),y+mix(9,5,u),mix(-30,-18,u));target=V(-4,y+1,0);fov=mix(65,54,u)
 elseif t<3.25 then
  local u=ease((t-2)/1.25);pos=V(mix(9,5,u),mix(7,5.3,u),-16);target=V(-3,h-.25,0);fov=54
 elseif t<3.75 then
  local u=ease((t-3.25)/.5);pos=V(5,5.3,-16):Lerp(V(6,4.5,-8),u);target=V(-3,h-.25,0):Lerp(V(3,2.5,-1.1),u);fov=mix(54,39,u)
 elseif t<4.25 then
  local u=ease((t-3.75)/.5);pos=V(6,4.5,-8);target=V(3,2.5,-1.1);fov=mix(39,36,u)
 elseif t<4.5 then
  local u=ease((t-4.25)/.25);pos=V(6,4.5,-8):Lerp(V(-.6,h+1.8,-7),u);target=V(3,2.5,-1.1):Lerp(V(-4,h+1.1,0),u);fov=mix(36,46,u)
 elseif t<5.15 then
  local u=ease((t-4.5)/.65);pos=V(-.6,h+1.8,-7):Lerp(V(12,6,-16),u);target=V(-4,h+1.1,0):Lerp(V(3,h,0),u);fov=mix(46,56,u)
 elseif t<6.1 then
  local u=ease((t-5.15)/.95);pos=V(12,6,-16):Lerp(V(8,3.8,-12),u);target=V(3,h+1,0);fov=mix(56,50,u)
 else
  local u=ease((t-6.1)/.9)
  local a=mix(math.atan2(-12,5),math.pi*.5,u)
  local dist=mix(13,17,u)
  pos=V(3+math.cos(a)*dist,mix(4,11,u),math.sin(a)*dist)
  target=V(3,h+.5,-1);fov=mix(50,70,u)
 end
 if t>=2 and t<2.24 then
  local power=(1-(t-2)/.24)*.25
  pos+=V(math.sin(t*133),math.cos(t*111),0)*power
 end
 return cf(pos,target),fov
end
local function makeActor(char,parent)
 local was=char.Archivable;char.Archivable=true
 local ok,actor=pcall(function()return char:Clone()end);char.Archivable=was
 assert(ok and actor,"Avatar could not be cloned")
 actor.Name="IntroActor"
 for _,o in ipairs(actor:GetDescendants())do
  if o:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or o:IsA("Animator") or o:IsA("Tool") or o:IsA("ForceField") then o:Destroy()
  elseif o:IsA("BasePart")then o.Anchored=true;o.CanCollide=false;o.CanTouch=false;o.CanQuery=false;o.LocalTransparencyModifier=0
  elseif o:IsA("Sound")then o:Destroy()end
 end
 local root=actor:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");assert(root,"Avatar root missing")
 root.Anchored=true;root.Transparency=1;actor.PrimaryPart=root
 local hum=actor:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");hum.DisplayDistanceType=Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None;hum.AutoRotate=false;hum.BreakJointsOnDeath=false
 -- Solve the visual rig directly, supporting both Motor6D and AnimationConstraint avatars.
 -- Anchored clone parts make the animation independent of physics and frame order.
 local links,rest={},{}
 for _,o in ipairs(actor:GetDescendants())do
  if o:IsA("BasePart")then rest[o]=root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(o.CFrame) end
  local a,b,c0,c1
  if o:IsA("JointInstance")then a,b,c0,c1=o.Part0,o.Part1,o.C0,o.C1
  elseif o:IsA("AnimationConstraint") or o:IsA("RigidConstraint")then
   local at0,at1=o.Attachment0,o.Attachment1
   if at0 and at1 then a,b,c0,c1=at0.Parent,at1.Parent,at0.CFrame,at1.CFrame end
  end
  if a and b and a:IsA("BasePart") and b:IsA("BasePart")then
   links[#links+1]={name=o.Name:gsub(" ",""),a=a,b=b,c0=c0,c1=c1}
  end
 end
 for _,o in ipairs(actor:GetDescendants())do if o:IsA("JointInstance") or o:IsA("Constraint")then o:Destroy()end end
 local function apply(p,world,handTargets)
  local rotations={RightShoulder=p.rs,LeftShoulder=p.ls,RightHip=p.rh,LeftHip=p.lh,Neck=p.neck,
   RightElbow=V(p.re,0,0),LeftElbow=V(p.le,0,0),RightKnee=V(p.rk,0,0),LeftKnee=V(p.lk,0,0)}
  local solved={[root]=world}
  for _=1,12 do
   local changed=false
   for _,j in ipairs(links)do
    local v=rotations[j.name] or Vector3.zero
    local transform=CFrame.new(j.c0.Position)*angles(v.X,v.Y,v.Z)*j.c0.Rotation*j.c1:Inverse()
    if solved[j.a] and not solved[j.b]then solved[j.b]=solved[j.a]*transform;changed=true
    elseif solved[j.b] and not solved[j.a]then solved[j.a]=solved[j.b]*transform:Inverse();changed=true end
   end
   if not changed then break end
  end
  if handTargets then
   local byName={};for _,j in ipairs(links)do byName[j.name]=j end
   for side,target in pairs(handTargets)do
    local shoulder,elbow,wrist=byName[side.."Shoulder"],byName[side.."Elbow"],byName[side.."Wrist"]
    if shoulder and elbow and wrist then
     local start=(solved[shoulder.a]*shoulder.c0).Position
     local wristTarget=target+world:VectorToWorldSpace(wrist.c1.Position)
     local upperLength=(elbow.c0.Position-shoulder.c1.Position).Magnitude
     local lowerLength=(wrist.c0.Position-elbow.c1.Position).Magnitude
     local delta=wristTarget-start;local dir=delta.Unit
     local distance=math.clamp(delta.Magnitude,.05,upperLength+lowerLength-.015)
     local along=(upperLength^2-lowerLength^2+distance^2)/(2*distance)
     local bend=world.LookVector-dir*world.LookVector:Dot(dir)
     if bend.Magnitude<.01 then bend=world.RightVector end
     local joint=start+dir*along+bend.Unit*math.sqrt(math.max(0,upperLength^2-along^2))
     local endpoint=start+dir*distance
     solved[shoulder.b]=CFrame.lookAt(start,joint)*angles(90,0,0)*CFrame.new(-shoulder.c1.Position)
     solved[elbow.b]=CFrame.lookAt(joint,endpoint)*angles(90,0,0)*CFrame.new(-elbow.c1.Position)
     solved[wrist.b]=CFrame.new(endpoint-world:VectorToWorldSpace(wrist.c1.Position))*world.Rotation
    end
   end
  end
  for part,offset in pairs(rest)do part.CFrame=solved[part] or world*offset end
 end
 actor.Parent=parent
 local head=actor:FindFirstChild("Head")
 local gasp
 if head then
  gasp=mk("SurfaceGui",{Name="ExcitedFace",Face=Enum.NormalId.Front,CanvasSize=Vector2.new(256,256),LightInfluence=0,Enabled=false},head)
  local face=mk("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BorderSizePixel=0,BackgroundColor3=head.Color},gasp)
  for _,x in ipairs({.29,.71})do
   local eye=mk("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromScale(x-.105,.24),Size=UDim2.fromScale(.21,.3),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(22,42,66),BorderSizePixel=0},face)
   mk("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)},eye)
   local shine=mk("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromScale(.14,.12),Size=UDim2.fromScale(.34,.28),BackgroundColor3=WHITE,BorderSizePixel=0},eye);mk("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)},shine)
  end
  local mouth=mk("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromScale(.4,.66),Size=UDim2.fromScale(.2,.2),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(47,58,77),BorderSizePixel=0},face);mk("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)},mouth)
 end
 return actor,apply,gasp
end
function M.Play(options)
 options=options or {}
 if player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") then return false end
 local char=player.Character;local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return false end
 local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
 local controls
  pcall(function()local pm=player.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule");if pm then controls=require(pm):GetControls()end end)
 local old={cameraType=camera.CameraType,subject=camera.CameraSubject,fov=camera.FieldOfView,cf=camera.CFrame}
 local controlsWereEnabled=controls and controls.controlsEnabled~=false
 local savedGui,hidden,skyParents,savedEffects={},{},{},{}
 local connections={}
 local folder,gui,grade,introSky
 local cancelled,cleaned,engaged=false,false,false
 local function restore()
  if cleaned then return end;cleaned=true
  if not engaged then return end
  RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("SnowArrivalIntro")
  CAS:UnbindAction("SnowArrivalLock")
  for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end
  for part,value in pairs(hidden)do if part.Parent then part.LocalTransparencyModifier=value end end
  for sg,value in pairs(savedGui)do if sg.Parent then sg.Enabled=value end end
  for effect,value in pairs(savedEffects)do if effect.Parent then effect.Enabled=value end end
  if introSky then introSky:Destroy()end
  for sky,parent in pairs(skyParents)do sky.Parent=parent end
  if folder then folder:Destroy()end;if gui then gui:Destroy()end;if grade then grade:Destroy()end
  camera.FieldOfView=old.fov
  local live=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  camera.CameraSubject=live or old.subject;camera.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Custom
  if controls and controlsWereEnabled then controls:Enable()end
  player:SetAttribute("IntroPlaying",false)
  task.spawn(function()pcall(function()Request:InvokeServer(cancelled and "Skip" or "Finish")end)end)
 end
 local ok,err=xpcall(function()
  local data=Request:InvokeServer(options.Preview and "Preview" or "Begin")
  if not data then return end
  engaged=true
  player:SetAttribute("IntroPlaying",true)
  if controls then controls:Disable()end
  CAS:BindActionAtPriority("SnowArrivalLock",function()return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end,false,3000,unpack(Enum.PlayerActions:GetEnumItems()))
  folder=mk("Folder",{Name="SnowArrivalCinematic"},workspace)
  folder:SetAttribute("Duration",7)
  gui=mk("ScreenGui",{Name="SnowArrivalGui",DisplayOrder=1000,IgnoreGuiInset=true,ResetOnSpawn=false,ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling},player.PlayerGui)
  local veil=mk("Frame",{Name="HandoffGlow",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundColor3=WHITE,BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=1},gui)
  local skip=mk("TextButton",{Name="Skip",Text="SKIP  ›",Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,TextSize=16,TextColor3=WHITE,BackgroundColor3=C(22,53,76),BackgroundTransparency=.3,BorderSizePixel=0,AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,1),Position=UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-24),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(118,44),ZIndex=3},gui)
  mk("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,16)},skip)
  connections[#connections+1]=skip.Activated:Connect(function()cancelled=true end)
  connections[#connections+1]=Input.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)if not processed and input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB then cancelled=true end end)
  connections[#connections+1]=hum.Died:Connect(function()cancelled=true end)
  connections[#connections+1]=player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()cancelled=true end)
  local function hideGui(sg)if sg:IsA("ScreenGui") and sg~=gui then savedGui[sg]=sg.Enabled;sg.Enabled=false end end
  for _,sg in ipairs(player.PlayerGui:GetChildren())do hideGui(sg)end
  connections[#connections+1]=player.PlayerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(hideGui)
  for _,p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants())do if p:IsA("BasePart")then hidden[p]=p.LocalTransparencyModifier end end
  local actor,apply,gasp=makeActor(char,folder)
  Art.scene(folder,data.Origin)
  for _,sky in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren())do if sky:IsA("Sky") or sky:IsA("Atmosphere")then skyParents[sky]=Lighting;sky.Parent=folder end end
  introSky=mk("Sky",{Name="ArrivalBlueSky",StarCount=0},Lighting)
  for _,container in ipairs({Lighting,camera})do for _,effect in ipairs(container:GetChildren())do
   if effect:IsA("BlurEffect") or effect:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect")then savedEffects[effect]=effect.Enabled;effect.Enabled=false end
  end end
  local shovel,light=Art.shovel(folder)
  grade=mk("ColorCorrectionEffect",{Name="ArrivalColor",Brightness=.025,Contrast=.04,Saturation=.09,TintColor=C(241,250,255)},Lighting)
  local fx={}
  for i=1,30 do fx[i]=Art.part(folder,"SnowPoof",V(1,1,1),CFrame.new(0,-1000,0),i%3==0 and ICE or WHITE,"ball")end
  local flakes={}
  for i=1,38 do
   flakes[i]=Art.part(folder,"Snowflake",V(.07,.07,.07),CFrame.new(),WHITE,"ball")
  end
  local glints={}
  for i=1,12 do
   local model=mk("Model",{Name="Glint"},folder)
   Art.part(model,"Vertical",V(.055,.48,.055),CFrame.new(),WHITE)
   Art.part(model,"Horizontal",V(.29,.055,.055),CFrame.new(),ICE)
   model.WorldPivot=CFrame.new();glints[i]=model
  end
  local trails={}
  for s=-1,1,2 do trails[#trails+1]=Art.part(folder,"Whoosh",V(.075,5,.075),CFrame.new(),ICE,"ball")end
  local start=os.clock()
  local frameCount=0
  local hold=RunService:IsStudio() and tonumber(options.HoldAt)
  local function render()
   local elapsed=os.clock()-start
   local t=hold or math.min(elapsed,7)
   local p=pose(t)
   folder:SetAttribute("Time",t)
   folder:SetAttribute("Beat",t<2 and "fall" or t<3.25 and "landing" or t<4.5 and "discovery" or t<5.48 and "grab" or t<6 and "hero" or "handoff")
   if gasp then gasp.Enabled=t>=3.6 and t<4.85 end
   local shovelCF=CFrame.new(3,2,-1.1)*angles(0,0,-7)
   if t>=5.12 then
    local u=ease((t-5.12)/.36)
    shovelCF=shovelCF:Lerp(CFrame.new(4.1,data.Height+2.4,-.6)*angles(0,0,-20),u)

-- SnowFieldService: PERSONAL fields with tile HP.
-- Each tile has a phase (0-3 layers left) and HP for its top layer.
-- Every shovel arm that sweeps over a tile deals its Power as damage; at 0 HP the layer breaks and pays out.
-- Updates are sent only to the owning player as triples: index, phase, hpPercent.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local DataService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local SF = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFields"))
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RNGConfig"))
local Balance = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Balance"))
local PetConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local updateEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldUpdate")
local syncFunc = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldSync")
local collectedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowCollected")

local TICK = 0.2
local TS = SF.TileSize
local SPEED = SF.Spinner.Speed
local R_IN, R_OUT = SF.Spinner.Inner, SF.Spinner.Outer
local TWO_PI = math.pi * 2
local MAX = SF.MaxPhase

local defs = {}
for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do
	defs[f.Id] = {def = f, origin = SF.Origin(f), maxHP = math.max(1, f.TileHP or 1)}
end

-- states[player][fieldId] = {phases = {}, hp = {}, pending = {}}
local states = {}
local function getStates(player)
	local st = states[player]
	if not st then
		st = {}
		for id, d in pairs(defs) do
			local n = d.def.Width * d.def.Depth
			st[id] = {phases = table.create(n, MAX), hp = table.create(n, d.maxHP), pending = {}}
		end
		states[player] = st
	end
	return st
end

local lastTime = {}
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
	states[p] = nil
	lastTime[p] = nil
end)

local function pct(hp, maxHP) return math.clamp(math.floor(hp / maxHP * 100 + 0.5), 0, 100) end

syncFunc.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	local out = {}
	for id, s in pairs(getStates(player)) do
		local maxHP = defs[id].maxHP
		local hp = table.create(#s.hp, 100)
		for i, v in ipairs(s.hp) do hp[i] = pct(v, maxHP) end
		out[id] = {p = table.concat(s.phases), h = hp}
	end
	return out
end

local function flush(player, st)
	for id, s in pairs(st) do
		if next(s.pending) then
			local maxHP = defs[id].maxHP
			local flat = {}
			for i in pairs(s.pending) do
				flat[#flat + 1] = i
				flat[#flat + 1] = s.phases[i]
				flat[#flat + 1] = pct(s.hp[i], maxHP)
			end
			s.pending = {}
			updateEvent:FireClient(player, id, flat)
		end
	end
end

-- damage per arm, from each equipped shovel's Power
local function armPowers(player)
	local attr = player:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels")
	local list = {}
	if not attr or attr == "" then return list end
	for name in attr:gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local item = Config.ByName[name]
		table.insert(list, item and (item.Power or Balance.ShovelPower(item.Chance)) or 1)
	end
	return list
end

local function collect(player, st, now)
	if player:GetAttribute("IntroActive") then lastTime[player]=now; return end
	local prev = lastTime[player]
	lastTime[player] = now
	if not prev then return end
	local powers = armPowers(player)
	local spd = SPEED * (player:GetAttribute("SpinMult") or 1)
	local rOut = R_OUT * (player:GetAttribute("ReachMult") or 1) * (player:GetAttribute("SizeMult") or 1)
	local bonus = player:GetAttribute("PowerBonus") or 0
	local pmult = player:GetAttribute("PowerMult") or 1
	local n = #powers
	if n == 0 then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

	local sweep = math.min((now - prev) * spd, TWO_PI)
	local pos = root.Position
	local gained = 0

	for id, d in pairs(defs) do
		local f, origin, maxHP = d.def, d.origin, d.maxHP
		if f.Style and f.Style ~= "Starter" and player:GetAttribute("Stage_" .. f.Style) ~= true then continue end -- stage locked
		local lx, lz = pos.X - origin.X, pos.Z - origin.Z
		if lx > -rOut and lz > -rOut and lx < f.Width * TS + rOut and lz < f.Depth * TS + rOut
			and math.abs(pos.Y - origin.Y) < 9 then
			local s = st[id]
			local x0 = math.max(0, math.floor((lx - rOut) / TS))
			local x1 = math.min(f.Width - 1, math.floor((lx + rOut) / TS))
			local z0 = math.max(0, math.floor((lz - rOut) / TS))
			local z1 = math.min(f.Depth - 1, math.floor((lz + rOut) / TS))
			for k = 0, n - 1 do
				local dmg = (powers[k + 1] + bonus) * pmult
				local a0 = prev * spd + k * (TWO_PI / n) + (player.UserId % 7)
				for x = x0, x1 do
					for z = z0, z1 do
						local i = z * f.Width + x + 1
						if s.phases[i] > 0 then
							local dx = origin.X + (x + 0.5) * TS - pos.X
							local dz = origin.Z + (z + 0.5) * TS - pos.Z
							local d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz
							if d2 >= R_IN * R_IN and d2 <= rOut * rOut
								and (math.atan2(dz, dx) - a0) % TWO_PI <= sweep then
								local hp = s.hp[i] - dmg
								local p = s.phases[i]
								-- strong shovels can break several layers in one hit
								while hp <= 0 and p > 0 do
									p -= 1
									gained += f.SnowPerPhase
									hp += maxHP
								end
								if p == 0 then hp = maxHP end
								s.phases[i] = p
								s.hp[i] = hp
								s.pending[i] = true
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if gained > 0 then
		-- equipped pets boost the snow you earn
		local pets = {}
		for n in (player:GetAttribute("EquippedPets") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(pets, n) end
		gained = math.max(1, math.floor(gained * (1 + (PetConfig.Multiplier(pets) - 1) * (player:GetAttribute("PetBoostMult") or 1)) * (player:GetAttribute("SnowMult") or 1) + 0.5))
		DataService.AddSnow(player, gained)
		collectedEvent:FireClient(player, gained)
	end
end

local function regrow(st)
	for id, s in pairs(st) do
		local d = defs[id]
		local chance = 1 / d.def.RegrowSeconds
		for i, p in ipairs(s.phases) do
			if p < MAX and math.random() < chance then
				s.phases[i] = p + 1
				s.hp[i] = d.maxHP
				s.pending[i] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

local acc, regrowAcc = 0, 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	acc += dt
	regrowAcc += dt
	if acc < TICK then return end
	acc = 0
	local doRegrow = regrowAcc >= 1
	if doRegrow then regrowAcc = 0 end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local st = getStates(player)
		collect(player, st, now)
		if doRegrow then regrow(st) end
		flush(player, st)
	end
end)

local function tween(obj, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end

local MODES = {
	full = {anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.45), size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.78),
		aspect = 0.5, slot = 0.2, range = 3},
	mini = {anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.01), size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.27),
		aspect = 0.8, slot = 1 / 3.1, range = 1},
}
local minimized = false
local mode = MODES.full

local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
blur.Name = "RollBlur"
blur.Size = 0
blur.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function updateBackdrop(instant)
	local on = stage.Visible and not minimized
	local t = instant and 0 or 0.25
	tween(blur, t, {Size = on and 22 or 0})
	tween(dim, t, {BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.5 or 1})
end

local function applyMode()
	mode = minimized and MODES.mini or MODES.full
	stage.AnchorPoint = mode.anchor
	stage.Position = mode.pos
	stage.Size = mode.size
	aspect.AspectRatio = mode.aspect
	glow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, mode.slot * 1.7)
	rays.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, mode.slot * 2.6)
	for _, p in ipairs({pointerL, pointerR}) do p.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.14, mode.slot * 0.42) end
	updateBackdrop(true)
end

-- REEL (7 recycled slots; slot for absolute index j = slots[j % 7])
--------------------------------------------------
local NSLOTS = 7
local slots = {}
local seq = {}

local function label(parent, props, st)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Font = FONT; l.TextScaled = true; l.TextColor3 = WHITE; l.BackgroundTransparency = 1; l.Text = ""
	for k, v in pairs(props) do l[k] = v end
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Thickness = st; s.Color = BLACK; s.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round; s.Parent = l
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

for i = 1, NSLOTS do
	local cg = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
	cg.Name = "Slot" .. i
	cg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	cg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	cg.Visible = false
	local sc = Instance.new("UIScale"); sc.Parent = cg
	local odds = label(cg, {Name = "Odds", Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.25, 0.03), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.2), TextColor3 = GREEN}, 3)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = "IconHolder"; holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); holder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.48); holder.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.5)
	holder.Parent = cg
	local name = label(cg, {Name = "ItemName", Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.73), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.25)}, 4)
	cg.Parent = slotsFrame
	slots[i] = {cg = cg, scale = sc, odds = odds, holder = holder, name = name, item = nil, pop = 1}
end

-- visual filler items: common ones appear more often, like the real odds
local weightTotal = 0
for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do weightTotal += 1 / it.Chance end
local function randomItem()
	local n = math.random() * weightTotal
	for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do
		n -= 1 / it.Chance
		if n <= 0 then return it end
	end
	return Config.Items[1]
end
local function itemAt(j)
	if not seq[j] then seq[j] = randomItem() end
	return seq[j]
end

local function setItem(s, item)
	s.item = item
	s.odds.Text = "1 in " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(item.Chance)
	s.name.Text = string.upper(item.Name)
	s.holder:ClearAllChildren()
	ItemIcon.create(item).Parent = s.holder
end

local posValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
posValue.Value = 0
local lastPos, speed = 0, 0

local function render()
	local pos = posValue.Value
	local base = math.floor(pos + 0.5)
	local range = mode.range
	local used = {}
	local motion = math.clamp(speed / 35, 0, 1)
	for j = base - range, base + range do
		local s = slots[(j % NSLOTS) + 1]
		used[s] = true
		local item = itemAt(j)
		if s.item ~= item then setItem(s, item) end
		local d = j - pos
		local ad = math.abs(d)
		s.cg.Visible = true
		s.cg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, mode.slot)
		s.cg.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5 + d * mode.slot)
		-- fade + darken with distance, extra transparency when moving fast (motion blur feel)
		local fade = math.clamp(ad / (range + 0.5), 0, 1)
		s.cg.GroupTransparency = math.clamp(fade * 0.92 + motion * (ad < 0.5 and 0.25 or 0.45), 0, 1)
		s.cg.GroupColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(FADED, math.clamp(ad * 1.2, 0, 1))
		s.scale.Scale = (1 - math.min(ad, 2) * 0.17) * s.pop
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(slots) do
		if not used[s] then s.cg.Visible = false end
	end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	local p = posValue.Value
	speed = math.abs(p - lastPos) / math.max(dt, 1e-3)
	lastPos = p
	rays.Rotation = (rays.Rotation + dt * 20) % 360
	if stage.Visible then render() end
end)

-- ROLL
--------------------------------------------------
local rolling, rollId, lastFire = false, 0, 0
local waiting
remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(result, counts, equipped, luck)
	if waiting then waiting(result, counts, equipped, luck) end
end)

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local punching = false
local function fovPunch()
	if punching then return end
	punching = true
	local base = camera.FieldOfView
	tween(camera, 0.08, {FieldOfView = base - 6}).Completed:Wait()
	tween(camera, 0.35, {FieldOfView = base}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Wait()
	punching = false
end

local function showStage()
	gui:SetAttribute("Rolling", true)
	if not stage.Visible then
		stage.Visible = true
		render()
		updateBackdrop()
	end
end
local function hideStage()
	gui:SetAttribute("Rolling", false)
	stage.Visible = false
	updateBackdrop()
end

local function doRoll()
	if rolling or gui:GetAttribute("RebirthMenuOpen") or game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") then return end
	rolling = true
	rollId += 1
	local myId = rollId

	local animScale = game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RollAnimScale") or 1
	local gap = (Config.RollCooldown * animScale + 0.1) - (os.clock() - lastFire)
	if gap > 0 then task.wait(gap) end

	local result, counts, equipped, luck
	waiting = function(r, c, e, l) result, counts, equipped, luck = r, c, e, l end
	lastFire = os.clock()
	remote:FireServer()

	showStage()
	tween(rays, 0.2, {GroupTransparency = 0.55})
	tween(glowScale, 0.2, {Scale = 1})

	-- creep the reel while the server answers
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while result == nil and os.clock() - t0 < 3 do
		posValue.Value += 0.15
		task.wait()
	end
	waiting = nil
	if not result then
		rolling = false
		hideStage()
		return
	end

	local fast = gui:GetAttribute("FastRolls")
	local base = math.floor(posValue.Value + 0.5)
	local dist = fast and 8 or (26 + math.random(0, 6))
	local target = base + dist
	for j = base + 1, target + 4 do seq[j] = randomItem() end
	seq[target] = Config.ByName[result] or Config.Items[1]
	for j in pairs(seq) do
		if j < base - 10 then seq[j] = nil end -- keep memory tiny
	end

	-- decelerate, overshoot a touch, settle back onto the winner
	local wonItem = Config.ByName[result]
	if Cutscene.ShouldPlay(wonItem, luck) then
		-- RARE: reel starts, then the screen cuts to black for the cutscene
		local tw = tween(posValue, 3.1, {Value = target + 0.22}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
		task.wait(0.9)
		Cutscene.Play(wonItem, luck)
		tw:Cancel()
		posValue.Value = target
	else
		tween(posValue, fast and 0.7 or 3.1 * animScale, {Value = target + 0.22}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint).Completed:Wait()
		tween(posValue, 0.35, {Value = target}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Wait()
	end

	-- winner!
	local win = slots[(target % NSLOTS) + 1]
	local popV = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	popV.Value = 1.3
	popV.Changed:Connect(function(v) win.pop = v end)
	win.pop = 1.3
	tween(popV, 0.4, {Value = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Connect(function() popV:Destroy(); win.pop = 1 end)
	glowScale.Scale = 1.5
	tween(glowScale, 0.5, {Scale = 1.2}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	rays.GroupTransparency = 0
	tween(rays, 1.2, {GroupTransparency = 0.3})
	if (Config.ByName[result] and Config.ByName[result].Chance or 0) >= Config.BigRollAt then
		task.spawn(fovPunch)
	end

	rollFinished:Fire(result, counts, equipped)
	rolling = false

	task.delay(1.8, function()
		if rollId == myId and not rolling then hideStage() end
	end)
end

local function bounce(btn)
	local s = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if not s then return end
	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1.1}) end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1}) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.08, {Scale = 0.88}) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.25, {Scale = 1.1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
end
